caveat: Research proposals are derived from the current Method 1 Galaxy Evolution synthesis; they are hypotheses and study designs for future work, not accepted claims and not tied to catalogued evidence.
policy: derived from local synthesis; proposed data named as future data, not existing evidence; no invented evidence/claim/cite/DOI/product bindings; claim IDs only in provenance

proposals.title: Testing whether AGN feedback directly regulates star formation
proposals.aim: Establish whether active galactic nucleus (AGN) feedback causally regulates or shuts down star formation in massive galaxies, rather than merely correlating with quiescence.
proposals.data: Integral-field spectroscopy from SDSS-MaNGA and SAMI to map spatially resolved star-formation histories around AGN; ALMA CO and dense-gas imaging to measure molecular reservoirs; Chandra and XMM-Newton to quantify AGN power; VLA and LOFAR to trace jet/kinetic activity. Each contributes one link in the chain (fuel, trigger, energetics, response); none is treated here as already-decisive evidence.
proposals.prov: Provenance: derived from the Method 1 wiki's treatment of internal AGN feedback (claim 2929, currently non-committal / unverified).

proposals.title: Disentangling internal (mass-driven) quenching from environmental quenching
proposals.aim: Map the conditions — stellar mass, redshift, and local environment — under which internally driven quenching and environment-driven quenching become separable versus degenerate.
proposals.data: SDSS and GAMA group catalogues for a low-redshift environmental baseline; COSMOS/CANDELS and JWST deep fields to extend to cosmic noon; Euclid and Rubin (LSST) for wide-area environment and weak-lensing halo mass. Proposed as the sampling grid across mass and environment — not as existing proof of either channel.
proposals.prov: Provenance: derived from the Method 1 wiki's treatment of joint internal/environmental quenching (claim 2931, debated).

proposals.title: Observational evidence for sustained maintenance heating in massive halos
proposals.aim: Find direct observational support for sustained AGN heating as a maintenance mechanism in massive systems, where current backing is largely simulation-based.
proposals.data: Chandra imaging of X-ray cavities and their mechanical power; XMM-Newton and eROSITA for hot-halo thermodynamics; VLA and LOFAR for radio-mode AGN duty cycles; compared against IllustrisTNG- and HORIZON-AGN-style simulation predictions. Simulations here are the benchmark to test, not the evidence base.
proposals.prov: Provenance: derived from the Method 1 wiki's treatment of maintenance heating (claim 2946, reported / simulation-supported).

proposals.title: A prioritized observational agenda for under-supported parts of the galaxy-evolution picture
proposals.aim: Identify which parts of the standard galaxy-evolution narrative are currently least backed by direct evidence, and rank them by how tractably new data could ground them.
proposals.data: Wide statistical surveys as the proposed grounding source: DESI spectroscopy, SDSS legacy imaging/spectroscopy, Euclid and Rubin (LSST) for scale, and JWST for the high-redshift frontier. Listed as candidate data to recruit, not as current support.
proposals.prov: Provenance: derived from the Method 1 wiki's coverage map (only two of nine sections carry direct evidence; the rest are narrative-only).

proposals.title: How robust are galaxy-evolution conclusions to how evidence is counted?
proposals.aim: Test whether qualitative conclusions change when supporting literature is counted by distinct study rather than by record, and when incompletely catalogued records are fully resolved.
proposals.data: The method's existing literature corpus, with the NASA ADS bibliographic database proposed as the resolution source for incompletely catalogued references. No new observations required; this is a methods study.
proposals.prov: Provenance: derived from the Method 1 wiki's evidence tables (record-vs-study counts; several references catalogued only as identifiers).

proposals.title: Defining acceptance criteria for AGN-feedback conclusions
proposals.aim: Propose explicit, pre-registered observational thresholds that would justify promoting AGN-feedback statements from tentative to established.
proposals.data: The combined observational programs above (resolved star-formation regulation, channel separation, and maintenance-heating measurements) as the inputs a promotion decision would draw on — proposed evidence to gather, not evidence in hand.
proposals.prov: Provenance: derived from the Method 1 wiki's AGN feedback & quenching section (its bound statements sit below an 'accepted' level).
